results.rationale: Consistency: three drawers, round metal knobs, beveled top/base and gray cabinet identity remain; scene and placement changes are authorized. Instruction: warm wall, oak floor, right curtain, gentle shadows and the complete requested slogan appear, but the slogan is bold italic rather than thin-line and little right-side blank space remains. Quality: legible text and plausible cabinet, textile, flooring and lighting.

Consistency: black/red helmet design, dark visor, side vents and gray background remain, excluding viewpoint-related changes. Instruction: frontal symmetry improves, but the visible crown is still much taller and the chin/visor proportions differ markedly from the eye-level reference, indicating an elevated view. Quality: clean continuous shell and visor geometry, coherent reflections and no obvious artifacts.
